title: Undrift configuration
description: Points Undrift at a design system's own artefacts. Generated by `undrift init`.

system.description: The design system's package name, e.g. @acme/ds. Used in violation messages and as the default systemImports entry.

tokens.description: Path to a JSON token file that maps custom property names to values, as a token build flattens them: { "--color-primary": "#3b5bdb" }. A nested DTCG tree is not read, and a file with no key starting with -- is reported as declaring no tokens. Merged with tokensCss; later sources win on collision.

tokensCss.description: Path, or paths, to stylesheets declaring CSS custom properties. Merged in order after `tokens`. light-dark(a, b) values resolve to a.

primitives.description: The design system's own primitives: the raw palette and scales its roles are built on, as token names or globs where * stands for any run of characters, for example ["--color-primitive-*", "--dimension-*"]. no-primitive-tokens flags a reference to exactly these, and does not run where none are declared, because the token graph cannot tell a role (--accent) from a palette step (--blue-9). A declared name that matches no token is reported under Not checked.

primitivesSource.description: Where the list in primitives came from, set by `undrift init` when it wrote the list as a suggestion from the token graph. A person checks the list and removes this line. Undrift does not read it.

catalog.description: Path to a CATALOG.md. Richer than componentsFrom (carries for/not-for prose), but treated as possibly incomplete, so no-unknown-components will not fire against it.

componentsFrom.description: Where the component list comes from: one path, or a list. Each is a type declaration entry (.d.ts, .d.mts or .d.cts), whose re-exports are followed so compound parts such as TableRow are found, or a folder of component source inside the app (`undrift init --components`). The names of every entry are joined. A list read from every entry is complete, which enables no-unknown-components. An entry that is missing or cannot be read leaves it incomplete, and the rule is reported as not run.

componentsRoot.description: Directory of component source, used by `undrift audit` for docs-coverage.

systemImports.description: Import specifiers treated as the design system: one string, or a list. Subpaths match automatically. Defaults to [system]. When it is given, even as an empty list, it replaces system, so an empty list means nothing counts as the system and no-unknown-components cannot run.

exemptMarker.description: Comment marker granting a per-line exemption. Must be followed by ': <reason>'. A bare marker does not exempt.

intrinsics.description: Raw HTML elements that have a system equivalent, by tag ("button") or, for an input, by type ("input[type=checkbox]"). An <input> with no type, or a text-like one, is checked against "input"; a hidden input is never flagged; any other type with no key of its own is not checked, and the gate says so. null means the element is still banned but has no replacement to name.

foreignUi.description: Import prefixes treated as competing UI libraries.

ignore.description: Files Undrift is told not to account for as not checked, each glob with the reason. It covers UI files (.tsx, .jsx) that no profile covers and stylesheets (.css, .scss, .sass, .less), which Undrift cannot check yet. A listed file is counted instead of reported. A blank reason is a config error. It never removes a file from a profile: a file a profile includes is still checked.

additionalProperties.description: Why these files are not checked. Required, never blank.

profiles.description: Named file sets and the rules applied to each.

include.description: fast-glob patterns, relative to the config file: one pattern as a string, or a list of them. Negate with a leading '!'. A folder whose name has parentheses or brackets (a route group such as (marketing), a dynamic route such as [id]) is glob syntax unless each of them is written with a backslash, doubled inside JSON: "app/\\(marketing\\)/**".

rules.description: Omit to apply the default rules; no-primitive-tokens and no-default-palette run only when listed. An empty list is a config error: it would turn every rule off.
